translated: Yay! Is everyone having a good time?
Good. It looks like they're enjoying themselves.
Yeah! But... I've started to want to hear everyone's voices even more.
Next, let's all try doing it together.
Oh, that sounds like fun. Well then, let's all try saying "Yay!" together.
Ready, set...
"Yay!"
Thank you! I'm so happy you came to see us today!
It's so reassuring to know that everyone here is always watching over those kids with us.
Oh, hey, hey! Since we're here, why don't we all go see how they're doing?
It sounds like they're doing something interesting today!
That sounds like a good idea. It seems LEN and the others went yesterday, too.
Is everyone ready?
Well then... here we go!
Phew...
That was fun.
Good work, everyone.
That music parade through the city was so much fun, wasn't it?
Yeah.
Thanks to the theme of "delivering gratitude through music," I really felt motivated.
Hoshino-san, your opening was really great, too.
I could really feel your emotions.
Eh?
Oh.
I'm so happy to hear you say that, Kanade-san.
The confetti fluttering during the chorus was nice, too.
Who came up with that production?
That was Saki.
It sounds like she got the idea from Tsukasa-san.
Ah.
So that's why Tsukasa-san... Tsukasa-kun, the other day...
Yeah, that.
The other day, he was carrying around the stock of confetti I keep at my house.
You're making me blush.
You seem a bit off, Kamishiro-senpai.
Maybe you're just too fired up?
But I didn't know there was such a thing as "stock confetti."
Of course.
Confetti is essential for a show, after all.
On the other hand, Shiraishi-kun and her group really let us hear their talent with just their voices.
Well, we do compete with our singing.
Akito and the others seemed especially fired up today.
True.
The singing was really electrifying.
He went home right away today,
but I wanted to hear a bit more from him.
Right?
He said something to Toya about going to a shop nearby that has great cookies.
But it really was amazing.
The audience all raised their arms at once, it was almost hot.
Oh.
Were you okay, Kanade-san?
You mentioned before that you aren't very good with crowds.
Ah.
I'm a little... well, a lot tired, but the singing was so good that I didn't mind it that much.
Oh.
Really?
I'm glad.
But Kamishiro-senpai and his group stole the biggest hype of the day,
so I'm a little frustrated.
